meta.prompt_source: 用户提供题面（图画作文：短视频与窗外朝阳，字幕"你在看别人的生活，还是过自己的生活？"）

band.rationale: 对照第五档描述：'很好地完成了试题规定的任务'——描述、寓意、评论三项要求全部完成；'包含所有内容要点'；'使用丰富的语法结构和词汇'——倒装（Below the picture are the words）、定语从句（those who look up from their screens）、动名词主语与排比结构均有体现；'语法错误极少'——全篇仅 ourselves 一处硬伤；'有效地采用多种衔接手法，文字连贯，层次清晰'——However/In my opinion/Therefore 衔接自然，三段与三项要求一一对应。因论证深度有限且存在一处语法错误与一处搭配欠准，落于本档下沿。

dimensions.name: 切题与图画解读
dimensions.evidence: The picture depicts a young man sitting at his desk... while the morning sun rises outside the window. / The contrast between the bright sunrise outside and the dim phone screen inside suggests that real life is waiting for those who look up from their screens. / In my opinion, we should reflect on how we spend our time.
dimensions.deduction_reason: 三项任务均完成，解读紧扣字幕并利用画面明暗对比深挖寓意；但评论立意常规，未进一步展开'过自己的生活'的具体内涵。

dimensions.name: 内容展开与论证
dimensions.evidence: Nowadays, many young people spend countless hours scrolling through short videos, watching others travel, study and succeed.
dimensions.deduction_reason: 第二段有概括、举例与画面对比分析；第三段仅断言加建议（Watching others make progress cannot make ourselves better），缺少具体例证或后果展开。

dimensions.name: 组织与段落逻辑
dimensions.evidence: Below the picture are the words... / However, while they are watching other people's lives... / Therefore, it is wise to put down the phone occasionally, set clear goals and take real action

dimensions.name: 语法与句式多样性
dimensions.evidence: Below the picture are the words: "Are you watching other people's lives, or living your own?" / it is wise to put down the phone occasionally, set clear goals and take real action
dimensions.deduction_reason: Watching others make progress cannot make ourselves better. 一句中 ourselves 与动名词主语不同指，为本文唯一硬性语法错误；句式倒装、从句、排比运用娴熟，多样性达标。

dimensions.name: 词汇与搭配
dimensions.evidence: spend countless hours scrolling through short videos / the dim phone screen / reflect on how we spend our time / a life truly worth watching is the one we live ourselves
dimensions.deduction_reason: passing away 多表'去世'，用于时间流逝搭配欠准确（宜作 slipping away）；整体用词准确且有画面感。

dimensions.name: 格式与卷面
dimensions.evidence: 三段式布局与题面三项要求一一对应：首段描述、二段寓意、三段评论，标点与大小写规范。

consistency.adjustments: 维度分之和 17 一次落在第五档区间 17-20 内，无需调整。

sentence_edits.original: The implied meaning of the drawing is not difficult to understand.
sentence_edits.issue: 常见模板开场句，信息量较低，略显套路；直接点明寓意可使第二段更紧凑。
sentence_edits.revised: The implied meaning is clear: many young people are watching others live rather than living their own lives.

sentence_edits.original: However, while they are watching other people's lives, their own time is quietly passing away.
sentence_edits.issue: pass away 最常用的含义是'去世'，用于时间的流逝易生歧义；表示时间悄悄溜走更常用 slip away。
sentence_edits.revised: However, while they are watching other people's lives, their own time is quietly slipping away.

sentence_edits.original: Watching others make progress cannot make ourselves better.
sentence_edits.issue: 反身代词 ourselves 必须与主语同指，本句主语是动名词短语 Watching others make progress 而非 we，应改用宾格 us。
sentence_edits.revised: Watching others make progress cannot make us better.

improved_version:
The picture depicts a young man sitting at his desk, staring at his phone, on which short videos keep playing, while the morning sun rises outside the window. Below the picture are the words: "Are you watching other people's lives, or living your own?"

The implied meaning is clear: many young people today spend countless hours scrolling through short videos, watching others travel, study and succeed. However, while they are watching other people's lives, their own time is quietly slipping away. The contrast between the bright sunrise outside and the dim phone screen inside suggests that real life is waiting for those who look up from their screens. For example, no one becomes stronger merely by watching workout videos.

In my opinion, we should reflect on how we spend our time, because watching others make progress cannot make us better. Therefore, it is wise to put down the phone occasionally, set clear goals and take real action. After all, a life truly worth watching is the one we live ourselves.
top_problems: 第三段论证以断言和罗列建议为主，缺少具体例证或后果展开，是内容展开维度失分的主因，也是本篇停留在第五档下沿的原因。
硬性语法错误一处：动名词短语作主语时宾语误用 ourselves（应作 us）；另有 pass away（多表'去世'）用于时间流逝，搭配欠准确。
第二段开头使用低信息量模板句（The implied meaning of the drawing is not difficult to understand），在 163 词的篇幅里挤占了本可用于例证的空间。
practice_advice: 评论段固定采用'观点—原因—例子—建议'四步法：写完建议句后强制补一个 12-20 词的具体例证句（如 For example, no one becomes stronger merely by watching workout videos），把约 20 词固定分配给例子，将断言升级为论证。

patterns: The contrast between A and B suggests that ...（借画面细节做寓意解读）
Below the picture are the words: "..."（倒装引出字幕）
While they are ..., their own time is quietly slipping away.（今昔/内外对比句式）
It is wise to put down ... occasionally, set ... and take ...（三联建议收束）
A life truly worth watching is the one we live ourselves.（呼应标题的收尾句）
